title: Oozing Polish Egg Curry
description: A pungent, light midnight craving dish that marries Polish simplicity with Indian spice.

ingredients.name: garam masala
ingredients.notes: freshly ground with mortar and pestle

instructions: Warm the olive oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle the freshly ground garam masala, cumin, and coriander into the pot, stirring to coat the aromatics for 30 seconds.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Crack the eggs directly into the simmering curry, spacing them evenly, and cover the pot with a lid.
Simmer the eggs for 5 to 7 minutes until the whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Remove the pot from heat and stir in a teaspoon of sugar and lemon juice to balance acidity.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving into bowls.
